system.description: You have no sense of smell or taste and cannot attempt any challenge that involves either sense; however, any supernatural attack involving horrific odors or tastes does not affect you either. You may not take this Flaw together with the Merit: Acute Sense (Smell or Taste). You automatically lose any challenge relating to smell or taste, and Heightened Senses for smell or taste has no effect on you.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
